restaurantName: Tiong Bahru Lien Fa Shui Jing Pau
address: Alexandra Village Food Centre, #01-10, Blk 120 Bukit Merah Lane 1, 150120, Singapore
bio: The teochew dumplings are stuffed with jicama for a lovely crunch, while chopped dried shrimps lend briny umami. Try them with the home-made chilli sauce. Dumplings with red bean or taro paste filling are available after 1pm....
